nom: COSRX One Step Original Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow Pad

avis.texte: So far I'm loving this product!!! I have been using these on my neck and chest. I will definitely buy again.

I bought these to use on my jaw line and my turkey neck. I cant tell if its helping, its to soon. But I have very sensitive skin and it caused no irritation. I would of liked it better if it werent so tacky. I wanted to use it at night but it never seems to dry. Also I have arthritis in my hands and its hard for me to get them apart. So even though I had no issues I would rather use a serum that drys more and wont reorder them.
My skin looks plumper, softer and more hydrated after using it.

Great product! Definitely leaves my skin glowing and dewy. The size of the product is awesome and i love the built in tweezers in the lid. I have sensitive skin, so i worry about products irritating my skin but these don't sting at all! I have these in three different colors and love them all and use them depending on my skins needs for that day. Definitely easy to incorporate into your skin care routine!
Instant glow! Great for sensitive skin and aging skin looks glowing.
It's a great idea to make a large pads. Love it and recommend!!
I love these collagen pads, it does leave a little glow to my face!
This toner pad is a game changer, it hydrates my skin and removes dark spots. Love this so much.

I've been using the CosRx One Step Original Peptide Collagen Glow Pads for a bit now and honestly, they're such an easy win for my routine. The pads are super gentle but still leave my skin noticeably smoother and more hydrated right after use. I like that they don't feel overly harsh or tingly-just very refreshing. What I've noticed most is the subtle glow they give. With continued use, my skin looks more plump and even. These look pads are perfect for a day when you aren't looking for a multi-step routine. Bonus points for the large number of pads you receive! Highly recommend!

I am so happy I received these toner pads! I read the ingredient list and was immediately impressed. The pads are well saturated, thin, and have a contour that makes them perfect for placing around your face. I used them at the beginning of my routine and let them sit on my skin for about 10 minutes. Wow is all I can say. The level of hydration and the glow when they dried down are so good. You get 100 pads which is very impressive.
Love my peptide pads! I use it after my toner and befor my serums and it's really given me a nice glassy glow

avis.titre: Bouncy skin and instant hydration boost!
avis.texte: This has helped keep my combination evenly and visibly hydrated. The shape of the pads work great as a mask for my undereyes and smile lines and after a couple weeks I've noticed that wrinkles have been reduced and my genetic hollow undereyes looked a bit more lifted and full. My skin does look glowy after a single use with no sticky residue. The product itself has a generous amount of pretty pink serum, every pad is soaked through! The serum is slightly watery, as a toner it is great. The product is very convenient as both toner pads and a mini mask. The pads are lightly larger than a cotton round. The tub is a pretty big size, I keep it on a shelf in my bathroom. It does take up a good amount of space, but the label and pink color of the tub are aesthetically pleasing to the eye. The ingredients make a good combination in a single product. The collagen and B-12 (makes it pink!) are great for calming any redness and puffiness as skin prep in the am. The niancinamide and adenosine has helped even my skintone and rid me of those little bumps over time. With hyaluronic acid and peptides my skin hydration has been more consistent on a day to day basis. Overall, I'm very happy with this product and want to try the other toner pads, but this one has worked so well it'll be hard to switch!

What a nice surprise! The jar is filled with serum, so each pad is soaked. The jar has 100 pads and infused with pink peptides and collagen leaving you glowing and moist. I would prefer the pads to have a texture so it can give a slight exfoliation when wiping down.I prefer the open top lid vs the twist and close lid, making it easier to access.
Feels nice, haven't used it long enough to notice a huge difference but so far I like it.

Peptide Glow Pads are amazing. After washing my face, I just swipe one of these on and I'm done or I leave on for a few minutes as a mask. They aren't greasy or sticky, which is a major plus , but they actually make my skin look hydrated and less tired . I've noticed my skin feels firmer and looks clean and soft in the mornings. The tweezers in the cap are a perfectly added tool to keep things clean. Definitely worth it if you want better skin without too much work

Very fun new type of product to try. It comes with little tweezers that are built into the packaging. The pads are thicker than you would expect. Very hydrating and do not irritate my skin. Im not sure how much firming I have noticed, but its hydrating and provides a glow afterwards that makes my skin look healthier overall. I usually just use one pad for my whole face, but if you treat it like a sheet mask, you can use a couple and get your skin to really soak up all the good hydration.

I don't usually write reviews but today I had to take time and write about these Peptide Collagen pads. Why? Because they are magical, I suffer from sensitive skin and nope, no problems whatsoever. My skin feels Smooth, hydrated, firm, and glowing. And this was from the first use, the next day my face was still feeling the same, like if I had just wiped it. I love it !! And I recommended it for any skin type. And the size ! Amazing!! Fine lines ? Where?

avis.titre: If you have mature skin- meet your new best friend!
avis.texte: I was really excited to try this new One Step Original Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow Pad! The packaging is absolutely on point. The container is easy to open and comes with tweezers to gently pick up singular pads. It has very little smell. The pads are soft and packed with goodness. I love how easy it is to use. After I swipe my face, there is still plenty of serum left on the pad. I tear it in half and place one piece on either side of my chin, where I have some fine lines when I laugh. They stay pretty well and I remove them after about 10 minutes. The serum soaks into your face pretty quickly and my skin feels very hydrated and glowy. Not sticky at all, which is nice.I have had some issues with breakouts since I started using the pads. I have very sensitive skin, so I haven't narrowed down what the issue might be. I really hate the idea of not using them daily, so I'm hoping it will clear up shortly. I absolutely recommend trying these, especially if you have mature skin. I noticed a difference in some of my fine lines after a week of consistent use. Not like getting botox or a face-lift, of course, but a noticeable difference to me.

If you want hydrated, plump skin, you need the new COSRX Peptide Collagen Glow Pads. Im 56 with dry skin & this definitely smooths my smile lines by plumping out my skin & adding collagen is chefs kiss! The best refreshing step I've added to my routine all winter! It feels like a total drink of water for your skin. It layers beautifully with the Snail Mucin and doesn't pill. 10/10!"

I love these pads! They instantly refresh my face, add instant hydration and leave my skin with a gorgeous glow! The tweezers allow for easy application and the shape of the pad gets right around the contours of the eyes.

These pads truly leave my face glowing! After using every night for one week my skin looks so radiant. The pads are very moisturizing that I didn't even have to follow up with my normal moisturizer. And I feel a slight tingling and tightening for the first minute or so it's on. And my skin does feel more firm and still supple. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Gentle yet powerful, the One Step Original Peptide
avis.texte: Gentle and hydrating with a subtle lifting glow, the One Step Original Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow Pad is convenient and smooths skin, though the pads can tear if handled roughly, exfoliation is light, and the glow is gradual.
So good, so hydrating and leave the slin glowy and supply. Recommend 10/10

Received a sample to test. The packaging is cute and very pink. It comes with a tweezer. The pads are a nice size with plenty of product for my whole face. No perfumes or noticeable odor. After washing I wipe my face and then rip it in half to put on the dry areas of my face (under eye/top of cheeks. The pad is not a round shape so the curved edge fits nicely on the curve of my cheeks. After 2 weeks the dry spots on my face look plump and smoother. I think my skin looks more glowy. It has not caused any irritation to my sensitive skin. Using this feels like a mini spa experience! So give it a try!

avis.titre: Love the new Peptide collagen lifting glow pads!
avis.texte: I am in love with the new peptide collagen lifting glow pads! It has truly transformed my skin, giving me that plump, glowing glass skin. The pads are very hydrating. I used them as a mask and let sit on my face for 5 minutes and then I wipe the remaining on my chest, hands and elbows as well. The pads have given me that youthful glow and am ao excited to continue using them as well as other COSRX products in my everyday skin care. I recommend you try them out and see for yourself how your skin will transform into the glowy, hydrated, healthy glass skin we all want to achieve!

These are very nice and offer a nice moisture boost where applied. I notice a difference in the firmness immediately and the size of this is AMAZING! I do have a couple of reasons this did not get 5 stars. The thickness and material of the patches makes them slightly difficult to seperate, even with the provided tweezers. I soemtimes pull out 2 or 3 meaning to only get 1. Additionally, the serum itself is like a matte feeling on my skin. All in all, I would recommend this product.

I had no expectations of this product, but was pleasantly surprised when the fine lines on the sides of my mouth became less visible. After wiping the serum all over my face I will cut the pad into halves and place one piece on each side of my mouth for a few minutes as a mask while my face dries down before continuing my evening skin care. My skin really loves this product; it feels firmer overall!

avis.titre: I was gifted this product for my honest review - LOVE the pr
avis.texte: These pads feel very good on the skin. They are super saturated and I've used them a few times as a mask. They leave my skin so soft and glowy. These pads did not break me out or cause any irritation either. I'm loving the way my skin has been looing since starting. My skin has never been this glowy.

First off, the packaging is super cute! It feels youthful and fun! I love how it is sealed ensuring the pads won't dry out. My first thought was Wow, these look juicy!??They were loaded with product. I used two, swiping them over my face and neck and then placed them under my eyes. I didn't need to leave them on long, just three or four minutes and I felt refreshed. Taking another sweep over face and the I let my skin dry. Technically I let my skin dry, but it was anything but. I was hydrated and my skin looked glowy and plump! I followed up with PDRN B5 toner and then hyaluronic intensive cream, but honestly my skin felt hydrated enough just after using the pad. I am now using them daily and will be part of my long term routine.

First off, the packaging is so good! I love the large tub, the tweezers placement in the lid, and how many pads are in the tub. The pads are the perfect size to do my whole face and neck. They are also perfect to rip in half to place under the eyes for a little extra boost. And my skin. . AMAZING! I already love so many of cosrx products, but having this all in one makes it so simple.

These little pads are so convenient! Honestly, I've only used toner pads once when I lived in Korea, so it was super cool to have the opportunity to try these out in the US. I also use COSRX facial wash for my sensitive skin and was hoping these would mesh well with my skin too. Well, they definitely exceeded my expectations. The packaging is super cute and once I got over trying to twist off the lid (lol) the flip top was handy, with a place in the inside to hold the small tweezers. There is enough product to keep the pads saturated and it feels cooling on my skin to swipe these. No adverse reactions from my skin and it actually helped with my redness a little!! I did look brighter and more glowy.My ONLY negative, is that it left a slight residue on my skin rather than fully absorping into my skin. Maybe this is normal with pad skincare and I just didn't know!

I've used this consistently for a week and I'm loving it! Each individual pad has a good thickness to it and absorbs enough of the serum that it can be swiped all over my face and neck and I can squeeze the rest to pat onto my face (the serum is actually pink!) . My favorite way to use these though is to put multiple pads on my face as a face mask for 5 minutes. The size and shape are big enough to sit right under my eyes and I like putting one on my forehead as well. I have dry skin and this hasn't irritated me at all and has been everything I want from a hydrating toner pad!

I have only used for a week so tbd on long term results, but I love all the ingredients and the texture of the pad! So far it has felt great on my skin and have used just to wipe on my skin but also have left it on for added effect under the eyes/ forehead. It has all the ingredients I look for, and is super easy to incorporate into my routine. So far I love it!

I am very impressed and excited with the One Step Collagen Peptide Toner Pads. It feels like a toner and essence in one product. In addition to my morning and nighttime skincare routine, I applied this after cleansing, then continued with the rest of my skincare. Within two weeks I saw improvement in texture and a dewy plumpness, even my husband noticed. I will definitely remain a customer of COSRX.

I received my One Step Original Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow two weeks ago, and I'm already seeing amazing results on my face! I use it every night after washing my face and before applying my other serums. One pad is enough for each use, which I love. When I wake up in the morning, my face feels noticeably plumper, smoother, and more lifted. I'm honestly so impressed with how quickly it's made a difference in my skin!

I like the look and feel of the cotton pad and the texture of the serum itself. The pad was a very good size, so I used it on my face and my neck. The ingredients seem fine but my only concern was that my face started breaking out after I began using this item. I switched to only using it on my neck from now on and will continue to use it. I like the way my skin feels after I use the product.

avis.titre: A new part of my routine.
avis.texte: I love the tweezers that are included, especially since it has a little clip to hold it in place. Each pad has enough product to apply to the face, neck, and even the chest. I use it every other day and will continue having it as part of my routine. The glow has improved!
Love how this feels on the skin. Visibly enhances the texture of my dry skin.

I am really enjoying these peptide collagen pads. They are easy to use and, unlike the jelly ones, stay put on your skin (they don't slip around). The pads leave your skin deeply hydrated and feeling nourished. They are comfortable to wear and do not irritate sensitive skin. I like the size of them -- they are bigger than your usual undereye pads, which allows for a larger area of your skin to receive a boost. I have used them several times now and can see a difference in the feel and hydration levels of my skin. I highly recommend them to anyone who wants more suppleness in their skin. These are very good, especially during the colder months.

avis.titre: Hydrating for my sensitive dry skin
avis.texte: I use toner pads daily, and have tried many different brands, both Korean and non-Korean. I've been using this product for about a week and it does hydrate and give me a nice glow, prepping my skin for the rest of my routine. I can't tell yet if it has any firming or lifting effects though. I always appreciate that COSRx is fragrance free and works well for my sensitive and mature dry skin. I'm looking forward to finishing the entire jar of pads to see but from what I've experienced so far, I would consider purchasing this product.
Very hydrated and really make my face glowing. I haven't seen any lifting though, probably because I just used twice. Will continue to use to see.
At first I honestly didnt think it was making a difference, but I have been receiving so many compliments on my skin lately. More than anything I feel it gives you a great glow
Peptide Collagen its work for my under eye close to my cheek, make smooth and i using it every 2 day

The packaging is fantastic. The seal is easy to open, no ransacking the knife drawer. The tweezers have a happy little home on the inside of the lid that they easily pop right on and off of. The product itself is basic in a way that jeans and a tshirt are. I dont think any ground is being broken here but is instead a solid staple to rely on. The pads are really juicy, a single pad covers my entire face, neck, décolletage, and back of the hands. The product leaves a nice slip feel and dries down to a comfortable moisturized feeling for hours. I do most of my skincare in the morning after a shower but these have made it into my lazy nighttime routine. A quick wash, use a pad, slap on a good moisturizer, and lip mask. My skin is a bit more glowy in the morning now when I wake up and I have had no issues with excess oil or breakouts. It's a solid basic which is what cosrx really excels at.

I've been using it everyday and it has a made a difference on my skin for sure! Especially in areas that are really dry! I do deal with combination skin and acne around my chin in case you're wondering!
I love this. I have only used for a week but love the way it plumps my skin and makes it feel replenished. The shape of the pads are the perfect shape.

It's so easy to use in the morning, very hydrating, and fragrance free. I use it to replace toner. Sometimes skip the serum if no time, just put sunscreen after this. No dry patch all day. Super convenient for morning skincare routine.
I love the peptide collagen ! My skin feels amazing. As a woman of a certain age it feels great to use products that work. The packaging is adorable!

First off the packaging and design is so cute! Is very easy to open and use the tweezer it comes with to get the pads out. Each pad is saturated with the product so well. It glides on so smoothly onto my skin and leaves my skin feeling soft and plump. I will continue to use and see what it'll do to my skin long term.

I received my surprise! So excited with this product. Let me start with the packaging, it's absolutely beautiful with all that glorious pink! I applied the peptide collagen and it's feels so good on my skin!

I have been using this product AM and PM as my first step after cleansing for about a week. I have noticed increased firmness and plumpness already. The ingredient list is amazing and perfect for mature skin with copper peptides, collagen, adenosine, hyaluronic acid, and more. The liquid in the pads is watery enough to use before other toners, essences, or serums, so I feel like it really has a chance to soak in and work its magic. The pads are nice and juicy, and it seems like there is plenty of liquid to last the whole jar. The texture of the pads is very thin and cottony; they feel spongy and luxurious and don't fall apart or pill. The tweezers are a nice touch, but I usually just grab a pad with my fingers tbh. There is no added fragrance, which I love. The pads have a chubby crescent moon shape that makes it easy to use them as eye patches or as a mask. This is a nice touch that I have not seen with other pads. The pink packaging is actually gorgeous and looks nice on my vanity.I am enjoying the pads very much, and I hope COSRX will offer even more products with this same formula. I would especially love a toner or a toner mist (hint hint!)

Made my skin sooooo soft! I've used the Peach and Lily Lazy Day pads, and these are way better. The pads are really saturated and huge. Does not pill under makeup and fits easily in with my skin care routine. The packaging is really cute too.
This pads is very hydrating, my skin looks so dewy and glowing. It has immediate effect on my skin!

no one does peptide collagen like cosrx! i was super excited to receive this in the mail, i love the options this product has. for when i don't have time to wear as a mini mask i can just get a glow pad and wipe along my whole face and feel like i just had a hundred $$ service from a spa. if you love their peptide collagen hydrogel eye patches then these are a must have!

avis.titre: Big jar with lots of pads!
avis.texte: I really love the size of the jar! There's a lot of juicy pads so you won't run out quickly. I do like how hydrating the pads are. I also wish that they did not use animal collagen. I would prefer a vegan version.

These Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow Pads are a new favorite in my routine ??and honestly, these girls are juicy! :sweat_drops::sparkles:The pads are absolutely saturated with serum, which makes them perfect for a quick mini treatment. Lately I've been using them as an under-eye mask for about 10 minutes before the rest of my routine. They feel super cooling and hydrating, and my under eyes look noticeably smoother and more refreshed afterward.Once I'm done with the eye treatment, I don't waste a drop ??I use the remaining serum on the pad to wipe my face and neck, and there is plenty left. My skin feels bouncy, hydrated, and has that subtle glow that makes everything look a little more lifted and radiant.If you love toner pads that are serum-soaked, firming, and glow-boosting, these are definitely worth adding to your routine. Juicy, glowy skin in one step. :heartpulse:

I have been using the pads for 4 consecutive nights: pads then my retinol and moisturizer last. This is easier to use than a face mask.My skin feels supple and not dry when I wake up. I need to use this for a month so I can really compare the difference with the other brand (starts with "D")of face mask I have been using.

Oh my goodness! I received this as part of a promotion but this is my honest review. First of all I love a pad type delivery! So much goodness and my 67 year old skin drinks this right up and feels very moisturized even with just the pad my skin immediately feels more moisturized. I can't speak to the long term advantages yet but all of Cosrx products deliver and this will be no exception. I use this with my essence steps. I love how saturated the pads are. You won't be disappointed!

I tried this as soon as I got it and absolutely love it!! I had been looking for a toner pad to use as a mini mask and this came at the perfect time. As someone who's entire skincare routine is almost all CosRX, this is one of my favorite products from them. It makes my skin so glassy and feel so moisturized and bouncy after. I keep it on my cheeks first, then move it to my forehead and neck, and use the leftover toner on my arms and legs afterwards!

I put on pads two on forehead, and one under each eye. I then took a nap to let pads dry. . none of the serum seeped into my eyes like I have experienced before with other pads. My skin doesn't look incredibly plump and wrinkle free . My skin DOES look like it has a nice shine/moisturized without looking greasy, which I appreciate.There is no film left on my skin. Every bit of serum rubbed into the skin. This is very lightweight, definitely use this first, then serums and all the other things. The pads are thin, which is good, because the first bit I grabbed I thought, I'm gonna go through these super fast. But there were actually three all together.
These peptide collagen pads leave my face feeling tighter and firmer, but with a light touch. Nice scent, too. I will certainly continue using these! (love the tiny tweezers that are included, too!)
